_how_to_update: This file drives the PDF and the signing page. The printed comment is the comment field. comment_as_written, comment_clean, and interpretation_flag are source notes and are not printed. From the site root run: npm install && node scripts/build_condition_report.mjs. Reload the signing page to see text changes. To attach a photograph, save a jpg or png in the photos folder using the file name in photos[].file (jpeg is also accepted). Reload the page, then rerun the command so the PDF includes the image. Do not add this page to the nav, the sitemap, or robots.txt.

statements.prepared_by: Prepared for the landlord by Devin Desaulniers, Real Estate Associate, Axford Real Estate.
statements.form_note: This report follows the topics in the Residential Tenancy Branch sample form RTB-27. It is the landlord's own report. It is not a government form.
statements.move_in_only: This report records the condition at the start of the tenancy. It is not a move-out inspection.
statements.missing_fields: Not in the inspection record: the landlord's legal name, the landlord's address for service, the rental unit address, the date the tenant is entitled to possession, the inspection start time, the monthly rent, and the deposits. Each of those is left blank until it is completed.
statements.rooms_note: Rooms and items below are those recorded in the inspection. No other room was recorded.
statements.legend_note: Good, Fair, Poor, and Not applicable are the only conditions used in the inspection record. The condition is printed as it was recorded. An item can be marked Good and also have a comment describing a defect.
statements.maintenance_intro: The inspection record counts 7 items in need of maintenance or repair and does not name them. Every item with a comment is listed first. Every item rated Fair or Poor with no comment is listed second. These lists are not a guess at which 7 the record counted.
statements.tenant_statement_note: The inspection record reports 0 disagreements. It does not record an explicit selection of agree or disagree, so neither box is marked.
statements.representative_disclaimer: Acknowledges review for the tenancy file. Does not mean the landlord was present.
statements.timezone_note: The time zone was not stated in the inspection record.
statements.legal_note: This is the move-in condition inspection under s. 23 of the Residential Tenancy Act. The landlord must give the tenant a copy of the signed report promptly, and within 7 days after the inspection is completed, by a method of service in s. 88 of the Act (Residential Tenancy Regulation, s. 18). The report must be in writing, in type no smaller than 8 point, and easy to read (s. 19). It must include the landlord's and tenant's legal names, the rental unit address, the date the tenant is entitled to possession, the landlord's address for service, the inspection date, the condition of the unit, any damage or items in need of maintenance or repair, the tenant's agreement or disagreement, and signatures (s. 20).
statements.signing_help: Type the landlord's legal name and address for service, then sign in the box. The date and time are written on the PDF when you download or submit, in Pacific Time. Submitting emails the signature, name, address, time, and record ID to devin@axfordrealestate.ca.
